context: User requested direct image cropping because only whole images were available, then continued the crop task.

implementation.entry: Reading status -> uploaded image -> Crop image / cutout. Existing images need no re-upload or pre-upload checkbox. User-center status settings also expose crop and restore.
implementation.cutout: Local edge-connected simple-background removal, erase/restore brushes and undo. No semantic AI person recognition.
implementation.persistence: imageCrop distinguishes selected display from retained original. Reload never hydrates the crop back to the full original. Re-edit, view crop, view original and restore original are separate. Cancellation, stale jobs and failed preference save preserve the current image.
implementation.gif: Crop result is static PNG; retained original GIF bytes are unchanged and recoverable in the browser/origin holding the original.
implementation.cloudBoundary: Existing account state carries static crop/source preview, not original files. Preview-only devices receive a resolution warning. No physical-device or real signed-in synchronization test is claimed.

currentTurnCorrections.cropStyles: Retained source metadata no longer routes a crop into the original-only status wrapper; configurable color/shape and crop source marker survive.
currentTurnCorrections.originalReadiness: Bounded shared validation accepts genuine successful load or decode. A pending-decode test and corrupt-original negative control pass. This is not a claim that the earlier isolated pending case proved a specific browser defect.
currentTurnCorrections.fixture: Mock same-origin API POSTs instead of passing them to the static preview server. Keep pageerror assertions and preserve all original/GIF byte/frame checks.
currentTurnCorrections.portrait: Constrain canvas maximum width to its intrinsic rendered aspect so capped portrait height cannot introduce coordinate-misaligned letterboxing. Real drag and saved-pixel control pass.

live.evidenceInspected: All four archives downloaded, SHA256 checked and JSON parsed. Actual mobile selection screenshot inspected; it uses explicit test color blocks, not a real paper image. Pixel/alpha assertions verify actual cropped output rather than whole-image scaling.

feedback.31: Direct cropping/circular output/manual cutout sub-scope delivered. Automatic person extraction remains unimplemented; full feedback item stays open.
